author: ViTaLDRuG
text:
I watched the 1st video again and again. So we can only draw a FL if
the price has hit the target. And UFL is created by breaking a LFL and
hitting the target. LFL is created by breaking a UFL and then hitting
the target. Still we need to define the LFL and UFL, because world first
 ever UFL/LFL will not have a LFL/UFL to the left side. In that case I
think we can consider breaking a high/low to the left and then hitting a
 target as a FL. I was practicing drawing FLs for a long time believing
that FL is a kink that break something very important (such as, Pre-CP,
Tip of the CP, high low, another FL..) which later price hits its
target.

Next thing is defining the target. So a target can be a UFL, LFL, or Ignored QM level or a LSK. I think it hasn't changed yet :)

IF, I am seeing setups very similar to the EURUSD one. In HTF, we have a
 FL, then price engulf the mouth FL of that HTF FL, retraces back to a
local LSK, where we can actually short, which has a strong possibility
(small probability :) ) .

One is shown below. Purple color rectangle is a FL ( let me know if
not). Then its mouth FL is the FL 1. Price it the MPL of a LSK marked
with orange color in the top, then engulf down the FL1. Then retraces
back up to the Local LSK 4. Now I am waiting at FL 2, which is another
LSK.

HTF
